d:
Budapest mein ek safar, jismein tha World Athletics, Hungarian food, wine, family aur bahut saari masti!
Chef Sanjeev Kapoor is in Budapest to support Kriti at the World Athletics Championship, aur isi ke saath mil gaya is beautiful city ko explore karne ka mauka. Hungarian traditional food, paprika chicken, local Tokaj wine, Buda Castle, Matthias Church, Heroes’ Square aur iconic Danube River Cruise — is trip mein har jagah kuch naya dekhne aur taste karne ko mila.
